title: Animals and sounds
description:
Use inheritance and overriding.

```
Rex says Woof
Tom says Meow
Polly says Hello! (it can copy words)
3 animals, 1 can talk
```
hints: `class Dog extends Animal { Dog(String name) { super(name); } String sound() { return "Woof"; } }` (lesson 3.03).
`if (a instanceof Talker)` counts talkers; the parrot's `describe()` returns `super.describe() + " (it can copy words)"`.
requirements: An `abstract class Animal` with a `name`, an abstract `sound()` and a `describe()` method.
`Dog`, `Cat` and `Parrot`; the parrot overrides `describe()` and calls `super.describe()`.
An interface `Talker` that only the parrot implements; count talkers with `instanceof`.
stretch: Add a `kind()` method so the output says "the dog" without each class repeating the sentence.
